# Battery-Powered Callus Remover with Four Refill Rollers

## Smooth Heels Without the Salon Visit

Give your feet a professional-style pedicure at home. This battery-powered foot file uses a spinning grinding roller to gently remove calluses and dry, rough skin from heels, soles, and toes.

## Features Built for Everyday Use

- **Battery-powered design:** Runs on two AA batteries (not included), so there's no cord to plug in or charge.
- **Four extra refill rollers:** Every box includes them, so you can keep your tool ready for months.
- **Cleaning brush:** Removes loose skin after each session.
- **Lightweight, comfortable grip:** Makes it easy to reach heels and other hard-to-access areas.
- **Wet or dry use:** Works at home, in the shower, or on the go.

## Benefits for Your Routine

Keep it in your travel bag for beach trips and getaways, and skip the salon between visits. When summer dries out your skin, a few minutes with this file helps keep heels soft and smooth. Over time, you can also reduce what you spend on professional pedicures.

## Gentle Results, Every Time

Light pressure works best. Glide the roller over rough spots and let it do the work. Using it for a few minutes several times a week helps keep feet looking their best.

## Shop with Confidence

Add one to your cart today, or buy two and gift one. Every purchase is backed by a 100% money-back guarantee.
